home.closure: Reserve pending before open; only OSError from os.open means no returned descriptor. Registration exceptions remain unknown. Whole close loop protected, each once-close marked first; constructor completion and resource closure separately required. Only application-owned FD enumeration is claimed; Python/dynamic-loader internals are outside this ledger.
